q: Then he looks at a framed photo from The Daily Pennsylvanian, with the headline “Professor Thayer Retires.” He looks into a mirror, stunned by the face he sees there. And then he says, “Hmpf.” […] Like many older people, I too often say “Hmpf” when I look in the mirror.
2021 July 7, Jennifer Finney Boylan, “Katharine Hepburn, Henry Fonda and Me”, in The New York Times:
